english.notes:
(i) Section 5(4) of the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989 provides:-
Where an authorised officer or constable has required a person to produce an authority the person must do so
(a) by producing it forthwith to the authorised officer or constable;
(b) by producing it at a place and within a period specified in regulations made by the appropriate person; or
(c) by sending it to that place and within that period.
(ii) Section 5 of the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989 also provides powers to search the vehicle in question, test anything found therein and seize the vehicle and contents.
(iii) This offence was inserted by section 37 of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit on prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
